# Immutable rollback fixture

Production build of aidagame 1.2.0 at commit 20d42d0ba97840330084cf2de8937f9764b78456, copied from the pre-2048 backup. This directory is used only by local/CI browser tests and is never included in the published dist. repository.ts contains the unchanged storage algorithm from that version, with import paths/types adapted for the unit rollback test.
